result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I would recommend **QuickBooks Online** as the best all-around accounting software.

However, if you're a freelancer, contractor, consultant, or a small business trying to keep expenses low, there may be a better option.

Since you're in Canada, I'd prioritize software that handles **GST/HST, Canadian banking, expense tracking, invoicing, and year-end financial reports**\.

## My top 5 accounting software choices

![QuickBooks Online Subscription
– Youngblüm Consulting, LLC](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ZgHrB8oigEufRyuFGAnJb5xLCv8JTTFTuh-tJroDHKA-im6xXYHUKY5IyXqMXAn4XiAmA9iGGDzvBmRzmuCP5nnYiezowZhOKrQixuB8tQOCn-kwmHGQPey_5_wckO7vbwWRLyIGGAJrospfP2duINJHsMT-PeUh6ztD0dM7ZAm_N6XnyQYoxFtq7J7pZOxm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. QuickBooks Online**

(Best overall)

- Tracks income, expenses, bills and taxes.
- Connects to many Canadian banks.
- Produces financial statements for your accountant.
- Good for growing businesses and incorporated companies.

**My pick if you want a complete accounting system.**

[QuickBooks Canada](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/ca/)

---

![Xero – AccountKit Support Center](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/HOFZdHQfaXHdQ0Jl6FhQm1ZL8WDa2JXXY2s_IDNQw6_ClmY--iV2XW1k6Glaj1ICzU7IfOAztiKsPODuDYTSIw6PRmUslgzmZ5aMlPuGROKkGMtSJzGnCUzu5B8zEx6lZO3rd6Y_GILZvoN2_MXkKzeqqLSGOUSO0lv-UiE7fZFfvbCSDizWo5sdMixvhee4?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Xero**

(Best for growing teams)

- Unlimited users on its plans.
- Excellent bank reconciliation.
- Good financial reporting.
- Useful for businesses with employees and bookkeepers.

**My pick if multiple people need accounting access.**

[Xero Canada](https://www.xero.com/ca/)

---

![Wave Invoicing Price, Features and Reviews in 2026 | Techjockey US](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cq_WpVz7NNebV83eymwMqdJAwZrUT6jqdfnVn85XbYpCayHTlJrihkkO8LDrFvk-dswux7vYI-WyI9TwU0K5DaFdNOkf8d5Ia8Wr1grPRs_JxMDYMC_OytebLbRIC64BBKXa2wsOV86YjkDGJYJT3l4V90H4-W3LsFf4CLe4wjGwrIyhl4fSDhGvz9PUFynk?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Wave**

(Best budget option)

- Free basic accounting plan.
- Invoicing and expense tracking.
- Good for sole proprietors.
- Paid features available as you grow.

**My pick if you want to keep monthly costs down.**

[Wave website](https://www.waveapps.com/)

---

![FreshBooks Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RRvX6v49QkXlAnGf7iI3zuYuHq4Y5bCV2ND2uEGJjfjlSbrrgGFSfhAMTnFz47xKgD07CO5bDVnhMBo6jF3Yychs84_UW4qLs93k9PAEnaI8Kmr_xSKldMl1tHK69I4mDHX1xQ085ifzPdaKSnwyxyG_Y5668gw33P8XIfpZgJ8Lv3nST9TCXoqpEHKBFC7o?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. FreshBooks**

- Very easy to learn.
- Excellent professional invoicing.
- Tracks billable hours and project expenses.
- Great for contractors and consultants.

**My pick if you primarily bill customers for services.**

[FreshBooks Canada](https://www.freshbooks.com/en-ca)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Books**

- Good accounting automation.
- Professional invoicing.
- Expense and tax tracking.
- Integrates with other Zoho business applications.

**My pick if you want affordable accounting with automation.**

[Zoho Books Canada](https://www.zoho.com/ca/books/)

These choices are consistent with 2026 software comparisons, although the best fit depends on your business model.
